services.title: Permanent Roofline Lighting Installation
services.subtitle: One install. Every holiday. Nothing to take down.
services.body: Roofline lighting that goes up once and stays there. Programmable color-changing LEDs, classic bulbs along the eaves, or something in between — we install any brand and any style, on any roofline: tile, shingle, metal, single-story or two. Most nights it's just warm white on the front of the house. Then it's whatever the occasion calls for.
bullets: You pick the lights, we handle the install
Any brand, any style, any roofline
Mounted to last through Florida heat and storms
Most homes finished in a single day
services.image_alt: [PLACEHOLDER] Permanent roofline lighting installed on an Orlando home

services.title: Landscape Lighting Installation
services.subtitle: New installs and repairs to systems you already have.
services.body: Low-voltage systems rarely die all at once — they go one fixture at a time until the front of the house looks half-finished. Usually it isn't the transformer. It's a corroded connector, a dead bulb, or a fixture buried under five years of mulch. We find what's actually wrong and fix that. And if you're starting from scratch, we'll lay out uplighting for the palms, path lights along the walkway, and set the timer before we go.
bullets: Repairs and fixture replacement on existing systems
Uplighting, path lights, and accent lighting
services.image_alt: [PLACEHOLDER] Landscape lighting installed along a walkway

services.title: Entry & Exterior Lighting Installation
services.subtitle: Replace a dated fixture. Light a dark entry.
services.body: Sconces by the garage, lanterns at the front door, modern LED bars along a walkway. You pick the fixture — we handle the project from start to finish, including hauling the old one away.
bullets: You choose the fixture, we handle the rest
Old fixture removed and disposed of
Most swaps done in under an hour
